items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I got a call to go with Lionel Hampton's band... Supposed to join Lionel Hampton on the road... I got this call to join Hamp's band.

ctx.x: What year is this, that Buddy came back?

Let me put it this way...Let me get the years and things straight, because I'm getting a little confused on the time. Because all three of us were...After I was playing a couple of years -- this is the way it is -- after I was playing a couple years, I got a call to go with Lionel Hampton's band. That scared me to death. Nothing like going to play with Cy Jones, right? Supposed to join Lionel Hampton on the road. So I'm looking at it from a much huger...
Was this after Wes had done the same thing?
